title: CAROTE 5 in 1 Rotary Cheese Grater with Hand Crank & Strong Suction Base, Rotary Grater Vegetable Slicer for Kitchen, Veggie Slicer Cheese Shredder and Food Chopper with Container, 5 Sharp Blades
description:
About this item
Versatile 5-in-1 Functionality: The CAROTE Rotary Cheese Grater is equipped with 5 sharp, interchangeable stainless steel blades, allowing you to slice, shred, grind, and even create wavy cuts. From grating cheese to slicing vegetables like zucchini and carrots, this versatile grater easily adapts to all your food preparation needs.
Stable & Secure Suction Base: CAROTE Rotary Cheese Grater is equipped with a strong suction base that firmly holds it in place on any smooth, clean surface, like marble or glass, providing reliable stability while grating. The ergonomic curved design allows grated food to easily slide down into the container, preventing any clogging or jamming.
Easy to Use & Clean: The ergonomic hand crank design makes it incredibly easy to use, allowing you to effortlessly grate or slice food with minimal effort. All parts are detachable and dishwasher-safe, making cleanup a breeze. Simply disassemble, rinse under water, or place it in the dishwasher for hassle-free cleaning.
Safe & Durable Design: Made from BPA-free, food-grade materials, CAROTE Rotary Cheese Grater ensures safety while preparing meals for you and your family. The blades are crafted from high-quality stainless steel, ensuring efficient and precise grating every time.
Compact & Space-Saving: This rotary grater is designed for convenience, featuring a compact build that is easy to store. The removable container catches all the grated ingredients, making it perfect for prepping cheese, vegetables, nuts, and more without the mess. Ideal for any kitchen, it also comes with a storage case for the blades, keeping your kitchen organized.

reviews_5s:
I bought this to grate cheese. I haven't tried to grate any vegetables etc. I received this product in a timely manner and it was in perfect shape. Set up is easy and suction to the counter top is solid if you follow the directions. Counter top should be a smooth surface. The blades are sharp so be careful. Cheddar is a bit soft so there's a little resistance as you turn the hand crank. I chose the blade that gives large shreds and I am very satisfied with the results . There's a blade for finer shreds which I haven't tried yet. For the price, I paid $19 and change, it's a great deal.Very easy to change out the plates and use for cheese or sweet potatoes! Great buy!ITEM: CAROTE 5 in 1 Rotary Cheese Grater

PROS:

- The suction base is quite strong. As long as it’s secured properly, I’ve had no issue with movement while using it.

- It makes really quick and easy work of cheese and veggies - big reduction is prep time for me with far less fatigue!

- The variety of the blades is nice and gives a good range of options with even results.

- It’s incredibly easy to clean (but be careful - the blades are sharp).

NEUTRALS:

- There’s only enough storage for some of the blades - one set will always have to be installed.

- It can be a little frustrating to swap when you want to use multiple blades since you have to unscrew and rescrew the handle each time. Personally I find it worth it for the overall ease of use improvement.

CONS:

- There’s no lid for the storage.

GIFTABILITY: (All of my packages are sent with Prime Delivery Day and manufacturer’s packaging preference selected. This may impact how things are shipped and cause my packaging experience to differ from yours.) It came in Amazon shipping packaging (cardboard box) with the manufacturer’s packaging being a fully branded box. I find it directly giftable.

WOULD I PURCHASE? (Any prices noted are as of the time of writing): Yes, I find it great during prep as it greatly reduces fatigue. Unfortunately, I cannot comment on the value as it is currently showing as ‘unavailable’.

My rating system is: 5 = no/minimal complaints, very pleased 4 = minor complaints, overall satisfied, but could be better 3 = notable complaints, overall average to ‘meh’ 2 = significant complaints, unhappy and will not keep/use 1 = entirely complaints, misleading descriptions, straight to the trash product.First, let me say I've had something similar to this some years ago. I actually gave it away because it was too large, too cumbersome to use and a pain to store. This grater fixes all of those problems and I love it. First it is super easy to use and to swap out different blades. The design of the grater makes it very unlikely that you will be nicked or cut, provided you use it as instructed. What I really appreciate is the little holder to store all of the blades. This makes it so easy to store everything and keep the pieces together. The color is a creamy color which makes it perfect for any kitchen decor. The quality seems to be sturdy and oh, I have to mention the suction that secures the grater onto the counter. I have just recently become acquainted with the Carote company, and thus far, I've been very impressed with their products and this grater is no exception. I highly recommend.I've been pleasantly surprised all around with this. I thought it would be some sort of novelty, but I can see how it could become a very integral part of someone's kitchen. Easy to set up. Easy to use. Easy to clean (dishwasher!).

Lots of different attachments, so you can go coarse or fine with a pretty simple switch of blades. (And it comes with a handy organizer for all your extra blades.)

The bottom has a very effective suction cup. It holds well on Formica, but will lose grip after a while, so you might want to reseal it on occasion. If you were on a countertop without any texture, it would probably hold almost indefinitely. In fact, if you were on, say, a marble top, you could probably dampen the suction cup a little and it would hold forever.

I can see this being particularly useful for people with upper body strength/coordination issues when grating with a standard box cheese grater or mandolin. The crank handle is easy to grip, converting minimum rotational torque into fairly effective shredding force. And the plunger helps keep fingers safe! And after the fact, it's super easy to disassemble and chuck into the washer.

It might also be a great way to get kids interested in the culinary arts. Who doesn't like a gadget, right? And it's well satisfying to watch the cheese grating and dump into the bowl.

Everything works as it should and feels like it will last many years with basic care and consideration.This cheese/veggie grater works great and is so easy to use! I was confused at how to change the blades at first, I was making it too hard. It is really very easy to change them out and it works so well. The suction cup is awesome, it keeps the grater in place very well. We have recently been buying whole blocks of cheese and it has been a pain grating them but this is a life saver!! It grates the cheese so fast. The blades are very sharp and there are several to choose from for either cheese or veggies! It is also compact and very easy to transport, I will definitely be taking this when we go to the beach the next time we go!I've become a big fan of rotary drum graters and slicers. They work quickly to get a job done and are much more efficient than box graters and easier to clean up after than a food processor. And my knife skills that were modest at best aren't getting better with age.

I invested in a high end, brand name rotary drum grater. And I use it a LOT. In one example, I would never grate, chop or dice carrots or celery to put into a tossed salad because it's too much trouble. Now I do it all the time, good for creating a more nutritious meal. In fact, I use this device enough that sometimes in the same cooking session I find myself within I had two so I wouldn't have to clean up between each type of food, like cheese and vegetables. I thought having a second one would be useful.

It is.

And this model is a good one. Just like with the brand name model I have, it's quick to clean up because everything but the base goes into the dishwasher. The cutting panels snap in and off easily. The suction holds very well on a clean, flat surface. The whole design is very well thought out.

While the storage is convenient because the cutting panels have their own storage container, the nature of the style is that there aren't blades going all the way around the drum, so it's a little less efficient at cutting than the name brand model I use regularly. But they're sharp and whether I grate hard cheese or slice vegetables, it gets the job done better and faster than I would do using a knife of a box grater.

It is all plastic but for the cutting blades, but is well made and should hold up under plenty of use for a good long time. And for the price, it's a value.I bought this on a whim because I was tired of shredding cheese and slicing veggies by hand—and I’m honestly kicking myself for not getting something like this sooner!

The CAROTE 5-in-1 rotary grater is super easy to set up and use. It comes with 5 different blades that are razor sharp (careful when switching them out!). Whether I’m slicing zucchini, shredding cheddar, or chopping carrots, it handles everything smoothly without getting jammed.

The hand crank is surprisingly satisfying to use, and the strong suction base keeps it totally secure on my countertop—no sliding around. I also love the built-in container that catches everything as you go. It keeps my workspace tidy and makes cleanup a breeze.

If you're into cooking, meal prepping, or just want to save time in the kitchen, this is totally worth it. It’s become one of my go-to tools now—especially for taco night and salads!This thing is AWESOME. First of all it really grips the countertop (I used it on a butcher block surface with no problems). The rotary action makes grating things really fast. It's easy to clean. My only issue is storage—the case it comes with doesn't have room to store all the grating "plates", so one set will have to stay attached to the body. Also I wish the case had a lid so it was easier to stick in the cupboard.I'm reviewing "CAROTE Rotary Cheese Grater with Hand Crank & Strong Suction Base, Preservea 5 in 1 Rotary Grater Vegetable Slicer for Kitchen, Cheese Shredder and Food Chopper with Container, 5 Sharp Blades" which I received via the VINE program.

I've been using a box grater for a long time but I would prefer to shred items without having to hold onto them. So I decided to try this rotary grater. I have a granite island and this sticks to it VERY well when I turn the little knob to adhere it and it releases very well as well.

It took me a few minutes to realize how to pop the blades into and out of the base but once I figured it out, I was able to change them out very easily. I used one of the shredding blades as a test for a carrot. I chopped it into two pieces and put it into the hopper and put the top on. I turned the crank and started shredding my carrot. I had to put some force into it but fully expect that since it’s a carrot. Softer foods like cheese will be much easier.

I like this rotary grater, the exit of the hopper where the food disperses is at a good angle and clears out easily. It comes apart for cleaning easily and cleans up very well in the dishwasher.

I also really like the base that holds all the other blades too. I highly recommend but think the price point at $60 is a little high. Wait until it has a lower price but I like it either way.
